reference: User-confirmed first reference: frozen v4 850 genes x 17 components, target TAM_PGAM5_detected, original row_scale and scipy NNLS; no reference retraining or outcome-based feature selection.
inputs: Official GEO GSE14520 RMA series matrices GPL3921/GPL571, platform annotations, clinical Extra Supplement and official README.
mapping: Each platform: exact current supplied Gene Symbol; remove controls, missing symbols and multi-symbol probes containing ///. Aggregate probes by median RMA log2 intensity per gene. No aliases inferred and no missing genes filled with zero.
measurement: RMA values are log2. Convert gene summaries to 2^RMA. Divide each sample by the sum over all unambiguously mapped genes and multiply by 10000 only as a computational scaling. These are normalized chip intensities, not RNA-seq counts, TPM or physical RNA fractions. Samplewise scalar normalization cancels upon NNLS coefficient sum-normalization.
primary_projection: Use reference genes measurable on BOTH platforms, in the same reference row order for all 247 clinical tumor patients. Fit all 17 components simultaneously, divide beta by sum(beta), target coefficient is exploratory array-projected relative mixture coefficient. PGAM5 is not annotated on either platform and is omitted, never imputed.
grouping: One global median across all clinical tumor patients before endpoint exclusions; High > median, Low <= median. Same groups for OS and DFS; retain zeros. No optimal cutpoint search, no inherited TCGA numeric cutpoint.
primary_endpoints: OS: Survival months/status. DFS: Recurr months/status, using the endpoint label in official README; do not rename as PFS or create a new death/recurrence composite. Require finite positive time and event 0/1. Event 1 used as coded in official fields.
statistics: KM with 95% CI, censor ticks, beginning-of-time-point risk counts; two-sided ordinary logrank, independent tied-event risk-set reconstruction; BH across two primary endpoint tests. Unadjusted binary Cox HR and PH test. Continuous score per 1 SD Cox. Age/sex/TNM I,II,III-IV/platform-adjusted Cox on complete cases, PH diagnostics; secondary tests exploratory.
sensitivity: Both single-platform subsets of primary projection, with each platform's own outcome-blind median; additionally fit each platform with all its measurable reference genes and own outcome-blind median. Continuous and adjusted Cox on primary projections. No choice based on survival p values.
interpretation: Original reference failed abundance validation; microarray gene biases are not calibrated to single-cell RNA. PGAM5 missing, low gene coverage and mixed platforms further limit specificity. Any association concerns a reference-projected coefficient, not validated PGAM5-positive cell abundance or causal effects. No randomized experimental, independent mixture, or RNA/cell unit calibration validation claimed.
